subject: Television & Streaming
title: How Three Networks Ruled America
description: A 60-second lesson on How Three Networks Ruled America.

hook.text: For decades, ABC, CBS, and NBC controlled nearly everything Americans watched.

buildup.text: Each network had affiliates in every city. They decided what aired and when.

discovery.text: This scarcity gave networks enormous power.

twist.text: The FCC regulated content and ownership.

climax.text: The three-network era created a shared culture. Everyone watched the same shows because there was nothing else to watch.

punchline.text: Three channels gave America one conversation.

quiz.question: Why did the three major networks have such enormous cultural power?
options: With only three options, a single show could reach tens of millions of viewers
